item.title: [Due in 4 days] Final reminder: the MemberOf rule operator stops processing on 3 November, and dynamic groups built on it freeze in their last state
item.description:

A leaver stays in a group that grants access or a licence, a joiner never arrives in a group a Conditional Access policy targets, and an administrative unit stops following the population it was meant to scope. Nothing alerts, because nothing errors.

Entra · deadline 2026-11-03 · Query dynamic groups and administrative units for membership rules containing memberOf, list which Conditional Access policies, access packages and licence assignments target them, and replace each rule or convert the group to assigned membership before 3 November.

item.title: [Message Center] MC1526652 AI Builder credits retirement: Prepare to use Copilot Credits
item.description:
Microsoft is retiring AI Builder credits by November 1, 2026, replacing them with Copilot Credits. Organizations must plan and purchase Copilot Credits before AI Builder credits expire to avoid service interruptions. AI Builder features continue, but licensing and credit management require admin action.

item.title: [Message Center] MC1526651 Microsoft Teams: Malicious QR code detection in messages
item.description:
Microsoft Teams will detect malicious QR codes in messages, providing warnings for phishing or fraud threats starting November 2026. This applies to chats and channels, with QR code blurring for external senders. The feature is enabled by default via Malicious URL protection, requiring no admin action.
